# Dynamite FX

> > Professional special effects hire for live events, concerts, and festivals — specializing in pyrotechnics, flame effects, CO2 systems, confetti, and stage effects.

Dynamite FX is a UK-based special effects equipment hire company located in Epping, Essex, offering professional-grade equipment from manufacturers like Le Maitre, Galaxis, Ultratec, Next FX, and Wells. They provide technical support and equipment for live events, festivals, concerts, and stage productions with a focus on pyrotechnics, flame systems, CO2 effects, and atmospheric effects.

## Key Topics

- Pyrotechnics (indoor, stage, close-proximity, high-altitude)
- Flame effects (G-Flame, Flamaniac, Salamander, Wave Flame, H-Flame)
- CO2 effects (Psyco2jet, CO2 Jet, CO2 Gun, Freeze Fog Pro)
- Confetti and streamer effects
- Special effects equipment hire
- Galaxis PFE Advanced firing systems
- Smoke-filled bubbles
- Event production and stage effects
- Live event effects
- Festival special effects
- Le Maitre, Ultratec, Next FX, Wells equipment
